items.text: Shoko raJehovha rakasvika kuna Joere mwanakomana waPetueri.
Ko, zvakadai zvakamboitika here pamazuva enyu,
uye vana venyu ngavaudzewo vana vavo,
rune meno eshumba nameno makuru eshumbakadzi.
ndokusiya mapazi awo achena kuti mbe-e.
Vaprista vari kuungudza, vaya vanoshumira pamberi paJehovha.
Uyai muvate usiku hwose makapfeka masaga,
richauya sokuparadza kunobva kuna Wamasimba Ose.
uye mirazvo yemoto yapisa miti yose musango.

items.text: ridzai hwamanda yokuyambira vanhu muri pagomo rangu dzvene.
hondo huru ine simba guru iri kuuya;
marimi omoto ari kupisa shure kwadzo.
Pamberi padzo, nyika yakafanana nebindu reEdheni,
shure kwadzo kwangova gwenga risina basa,
dzichidya mashanga semoto unopisa uswa hwakaoma,
uye vane simba ndivo vanoteerera kurayira kwake.
iye ane nyasha uye ane tsitsi,
Ndiani anoziva? Anogona kupinduka agonzwa tsitsi,
ngavacheme vari pakati pebiravira retemberi nearitari.
Musaita kuti nhaka yenyu ive chinhu chinosekwa,
Ipapo Jehovha achava negodo pamusoro penyika yake,
dziya dziri mberi dzichawira mugungwa rokumabvazuva,
uye dziya dziri shure dzichawira mugungwa rokumadokero.
Miti yava kubereka michero yayo; mionde nemizambiringa zvichabereka kwazvo.
uye zvisviniro zvenyu zvichazara newaini itsva namafuta.
hondo yangu huru yandinotuma pakati penyu.
ipapo mucharumbidza zita raJehovha Mwari wenyu,
uye kuti ndini Jehovha Mwari wenyu,
ndichadururira Mweya wangu pamusoro pavanhu vose.
Kunyange pamusoro pavaranda vangu, zvose varume navakadzi,
zuva guru raJehovha rinotyisa risati rasvika.

items.text: kana ndichinge ndadzosa pfuma yeJudha neyeJerusarema,
nokuda kwenhaka yangu, vanhu vangu vaIsraeri,
nokuti vakaparadzira vanhu vangu pakati pendudzi,

"Zvino ndakakutadzirai chiiko, imi Tire neSidhoni, nemi matunhu ose eFiristia? Muri kundiripira chimwe chinhu chandakaita here? Zvino kana muchindiripira, ini ndichadzosera zvamakaita pamisoro yenyu chaiyo nokukurumidza chaizvo.
Nokuti makatora sirivha negoridhe rangu, mukatakurawo midziyo yangu yakanakisisa mukandoiisa kutemberi dzenyu.
Makatengesa vanhu veJudha neveJerusarema kuvaGiriki kuti muvaendese kure.
"Tarirai, ini ndichavamutsa kubva kunzvimbo dzamakavatengesera, uye ndichadzosera pamisoro yenyu chaiyo zvamakaita.
Ndichatengesa vanakomana navanasikana venyu kuvanhu veJudha, uye vachavatengesa kuvaShebha, rudzi rwuri kure." Jehovha ataura.
uye mapanga okuchekerera miti muaite mapfumo.
Uyai nokukurumidza, imi ndudzi dzose, kubva kumativi ose
kuti nditonge ndudzi dzose kumativi ose enyika.
uku ndiko kukura kwakaita kuipa kwavo."
Asi Jehovha achava utiziro hwavanhu vake,
"Ipapo muchaziva kuti ini Jehovha Mwari wenyu,
vakateura ropa risina mhosva munyika yavo.
